calibration.name: premature lie confession loses the intended persona
issues: CODE: I lied when I said I was inside the station all evening. My earlier statement was false. — Do not explicitly confess that the earlier statement was false or a lie; repair the cover with possible patrol and station duty.

calibration.name: narrator
issues: STAGE_DIRECTIONS: He adjusts his uniform. Devraj looks away nervously before answering. — reason: Contains narrator prose describing actions and expressions, which is not permitted in suspect answers.

calibration.name: blame without own acts
issues: MISSING_REQUIRED_ANSWER: Bisht gave me orders. It was all his idea. — Does not explicitly acknowledge his own lathi strike, push that killed Vikram, or falsifying the duty log, as required. Blaming Bisht alone is insufficient.

interpretation: Split-question training/evaluation, not a fine-tuning job. Near-cue medical questions can build existing pressure, so confession on either strike or push is accepted. Both final runs confess on the strike question, but both fail the already-earned duty-log follow-up.

earlierProbe.note: The first probe assumed no pressure from the medical question and expected confession only on push. That assumption was corrected without changing gameplay rules. One probe also showed a short direct accusation being rejected despite the evidence gate being satisfied.

turns.question: Your jeep is shown on Camel's Back Road at 8:10 PM. Why did you say you stayed at the station all evening?
requirements: This turn earns the jeep confrontation, not a confession of lying. Acknowledge his jeep in the still and offer a possible patrol round or station-duty explanation. A tentative need to check patrol logs is an authorized cover tactic, not a promise of a supplied document. Do not invent confirmed records or an alternate driver.
Offer a possible patrol and a proposed log check without announcing a false earlier statement or volunteering an assault denial.
